# simply_registry_nameservers (Resource)

Manages registry nameservers for a Simply.com domain product. Deleting this resource removes it from Terraform state only because Simply.com does not expose an API operation to remove registry nameservers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simply_registry_nameservers" "example" {
  product = "example.com"

  nameservers = [
    "ns1.simply.com",
    "ns2.simply.com",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nameservers` (List of String) Authoritative nameserver hostnames to set at the registry. Simply.com requires 2 to 13 nameservers.
- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, equal to the product object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import simply_registry_nameservers.example example.com
```
